create_NgAquacrop: create an NgAquacrop instance with a given number of soil moisture targets and max seasonal irrigation
run_NgAquacrop_loss: run the NgAquacrop loss function to evaluate crop yield for a set of soil moisture targets
run_aquacrop_model: run the aquacrop model with maize crop on clay loam soil using specified irrigation management parameters
evaluate_crop_yield: evaluate the mean crop yield in tonnes per hectare for soil moisture targets across 2016 to 2018
review_NgAquacrop_class: review the NgAquacrop class and its loss function for FAO crop management optimization
